verdict.rationale: Asaas is a payments platform, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question to ask of it. The pack documents no retention policies, retention periods, or customer-data deletion controls. The only nearby item is the ability to "remove or restore payments" through the API, which is routine record management (and restorable, so not true deletion) rather than control over data retention, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
